items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The Zustellungsurkunde on page 2 shows the letter was formally delivered ('zugestellt am 19.09.2025') on Friday, 19.09.2025 – this is the legally relevant delivery date for a förmliche Zustellung, overriding any presumed-delivery rule. Under §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is excluded from the count. Since the period is stated in weeks, §188 Abs. 2 BGB applies: the period ends with the expiry of the day in the last week that corresponds by name to the day of the triggering event, i.e. a Friday, two weeks after 19.09.2025 = Friday 03.10.2025. However, 03.10.2025 is the Tag der Deutschen Einheit, a nationwide public holiday, so under §193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day. 04.10. (Sat) and 05.10. (Sun) are not business days, so the deadline shifts to Monday, 06.10.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße + Gebühr + Auslagen) after the notice becomes final
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the notice becomes 'rechtskräftig' (final), which only happens if no timely Einspruch is filed. The Einspruch deadline (see other item) ends 06.10.2025; assuming no Einspruch is lodged, Rechtskraft would take effect on 07.10.2025 (Tuesday), the day after the appeal period lapses. Treating 07.10.2025 as the triggering event under §187 Abs. 1 BGB (day of event excluded) and applying §188 Abs. 2 BGB (weeks-period ends on the matching weekday two weeks later), the payment would fall due on Tuesday, 21.10.2025, which is not a weekend day or NRW/national holiday. This date is only an estimate: if an Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft (and therefore this payment deadline) does not occur on this date at all, or is postponed/cancelled.

warnings: The payment deadline ('zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft') depends entirely on whether an Einspruch is filed by 06.10.2025 and on the actual date the notice becomes legally final; the 21.10.2025 due date is only a best-guess estimate assuming no appeal is filed, and the person should not rely on it without confirming Rechtskraft with the Bußgeldstelle.

Several names in the letter (sender 'Zentrale Bußgeldstelle Musterland', place 'Neu-Musterdorf', bank 'Musterbank') look like generic placeholder/template names rather than a real German authority or bank, which is unusual for a genuine official fine notice — verify the sender's identity and the IBAN independently before paying.
